arguments.snippet:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. KYCSCHED1.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 WS-RISK-RATING PIC X.
01 WS-YEARS-SINCE-KYC PIC 9(2) VALUE ZERO.
01 WS-KYC-DUE PIC X VALUE SPACE.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
ACCEPT WS-RISK-RATING
ACCEPT WS-YEARS-SINCE-KYC
IF WS-RISK-RATING = "H" AND WS-YEARS-SINCE-KYC > 2
 MOVE "Y" TO WS-KYC-DUE
END-IF
DISPLAY "KYC-DUE: " WS-KYC-DUE
STOP RUN.
